title: ForgeCycle roadmap run state
description: State of one roadmap run, stored in .forgecycle/roadmap-runs/<roadmap-run-id>/state.json and replaced atomically (ADR 0026).

manifest_path.description: The manifest the roadmap run started from; roadmap.json beside this file is its snapshot

integration_head.description: The commit the integration branch points at: the base, then each done task run's head_revision

approval.description: Passed to every task run; present only when the operator gave --approval

auto_resume.description: Passed to every task run and task resume child as --auto-resume (ADR 0025)

state.description: A running roadmap run with no live process lock is reported as interrupted; that is computed, never stored

reason.description: Why the roadmap run stopped; cleared when it leaves stopped

stop_kind.description: Cleared when the roadmap run leaves stopped

stop_detail.description: The task run's stop_kind for task_run_stopped, the child's exit code for task_run_start_failed, or checked_out, moved, or not_descendant for integration_blocked; absent for pause_requested

result.description: result.md, written when the roadmap run finishes

task_runs.description: Every task run of this task, oldest first; the last one is the current attempt

base_revision.description: The integration head the current attempt started on

head_revision.description: The integrated head of a done task
